survey: A stylized coconut palm on a sand mound. The trunk rises from the sand, partly buried at its base, and curves gently to the upper left. It is segmented by horizontal rings and narrows toward the top. The crown sits on top of the trunk: about eight to ten broad, notched green fronds spread out evenly from one central point, some arching up and some drooping down. Two round brown coconuts hang in a small cluster at the top of the trunk, right under the fronds, touching each other and the trunk. The shadow falls on the sand to the right. Two small pebbles sit in the sand.
